messages.content:
Hi all,

The deadline for publicly sharing notebooks in this competition has been set as August 2 at 11:59pm UTC. For those of you familiar with Kaggle, this is one week earlier than our normal deadline.

You will still be able to make your notebooks after the competition has concluded, and any attached notebooks to a submission in the Strategy Competition will also be made public at that competition's deadline.

This does not prevent you from doing any work or making notebooks, simply from making the notebooks public on Kaggle.

Thanks for understanding!

messages.content:
I give this decision 10,000 likes! I really hope public notebook Sharing will be strictly enforced, especially in optimization competitions like the Santa competition that use 100% public test sets. I was originally very interested in the Santa competition and the ending golf competition, but I’ve seen many Kagglers complaining about it. I hope this year the will be fully implemented. I will definitely make time to participate in the Santa competition this year.

I even think that for competitions with 100% public leaderboard test sets, we could consider enforcing an even longer cutoff period before sharing is allowed — or even banning sharing completely.
